messages:
billing-bot: Vendor charge VND-9912 applied to partner bill for DeepSynth licensing 1024. Link: https://billing.redwood/vendor-charges/VND-9912

isabel (Finance): Partner Ops noticed DeepSynth license fee was billed twice on 2025-01-04 run. They were charged $10,124. Should have been $5,062 single license.

ryan (Billing): Confirmed two identical license line items on vendor pass-through. Looks like ingestion job retried the vendor webhook and created duplicate vendor charge.

marta (Vendor Ops): We received duplicate vendor callback due to timeout on our side 01/04 14:02 UTC; vendor portal sent idempotency token but our ingestion ignored it. We've fixed the webhook handler and added idempotency check.

isabel (Finance): Requested refund from vendor? Or do we credit the partner and recover from vendor? Need quick timeline for cashflow.

talia (Legal): If we absorb now, we should pursue vendor recovery. Please preserve vendor communication, include contract clause 6.4 for pass-through errors.

cory (Finance Lead): Approve immediate customer-facing credit of $5,062 as a one-time adjustment to keep partner experience smooth. Finance will open recovery case with vendor. GL: 4110; journal: CRD-DEEPSYNTH-20250105.

ryan (Billing): Creating credit memo CM-8241 for $5,062.00 to remove duplicate line on invoice INV-61190 -> INV-61190-R. Tag reason: "duplicate vendor pass-through - immediate customer credit".

isabel (Finance): I'll draft vendor recovery request and attach technical logs. Marta, loop vendor ops and legal on the recovery email.

marta (Vendor Ops): On it. I'll escalate to vendor AM and include retry logs and proof of our webhook timeout fix.

talia (Legal): Received. Will add contract references and timeline for vendor clawback.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-8241 created for INV-61190-R amount $5,062.00 (status: pending).

cory (Finance Lead): Thanks. Flag this as "customer-first - vendor recovery pending" in ledger and ensure GL entry posts after CM finalization. Keep internal ticket until vendor remits.
